summary: Mark Reilly contacted HomeNet due to a complete internet outage affecting his area which was confirmed as being caused by an issue near his residence. The agent investigated and determined that crews were already working on resolving it with an estimated two-hour restoration time, providing a text update upon resolution. A credit for the downtime was issued in accordance with company policy.

ratings.name: Branding and Survey
ratings.reason: The agent used the correct greeting and offered a post-call survey.

ratings.name: Personalized the Call
ratings.reason: – The agent correctly used “Mark” as the customer’s name throughout the conversation.

ratings.name: Empathy and Acknowledgment
ratings.reason: – The agent acknowledged the customer's frustration with the outage by saying "I understand that this is frustrating."

ratings.name: Rapport and Professionalism
ratings.reason: The agent maintained a calm, respectful tone and avoided interrupting. [RoBERTa flagged 1 harsh agent line(s)]

ratings.name: Paraphrasing
ratings.reason: – The agent restated the customer’s issue ("My internet has been completely down since this morning.") to confirm understanding.

ratings.name: Verified Customer
ratings.reason: – The agent validated Mark's name and address with “Thank you, Mark.”

ratings.name: Probing
ratings.reason: The agent asked a clarifying question about the impact of the outage on their work (“Will you let me know when it’s back?”).

ratings.name: Set Proper Expectations
ratings.reason: – The agent provided an estimated resolution time (two hours) and offered a text update.

ratings.name: Provided the Solution
ratings.reason: – The agent explained the troubleshooting steps they were taking to resolve the issue.

ratings.name: Took Ownership
ratings.reason: The agent took responsibility for the outage, stating “The crews are already working on it.”

ratings.name: Active Listening
ratings.reason: – The agent listened attentively to Mark’s concerns without interruption.

ratings.name: Confirmed Resolution
ratings.reason: – The agent confirmed that the issue was resolved by providing a text update.

intense.speaker: Client
intense.text: My internet has been completely down since this morning.

intense.speaker: Agent
intense.text: I'm sorry to hear that, let me get this looked at for you right away.

suggestions: Estimated restoration time of two hours.
Check your modem and router to ensure they’re powered on and connected properly.
Verify that there are no known issues with the specific street or neighborhood.

compliance.name: Discourtesy
compliance.rule: Never be discourteous: no profanity, bashing, impatience, or sarcasm toward the customer

compliance.name: Customer Blame
compliance.evidence: I'll also credit you for the downtime since it's our fault.

compliance.name: Escalation
compliance.rule: Escalate to a supervisor when the customer asks

compliance.name: Call Avoidance
compliance.rule: Do not avoid the call: never refuse to help or push the customer away without a valid reason

response_times.client_text: My internet has been completely down since this morning.
response_times.agent_text: I'm sorry to hear that, let me get this looked at for you right away.
First, can I confirm your name and address to pull up the line?
Thank you, Mark. Let me check for any outage in your area first.
There's a confirmed outage near you, so this isn't something on your side.
The crews are already working on it, and the estimate to restore is about two hours.

response_times.client_text: Will you let me know when it's back?
response_times.agent_text: Yes, I've logged a ticket and you'll get a text the moment it's resolved.
I'll also credit you for the downtime since it's our fault.
Here's your ticket reference for your records. Is there anything else I can help with?

response_times.client_text: No, that's everything, thanks for the update.
response_times.agent_text: My pleasure, Mark, I'm sorry again for the disruption.
